reasons: Panel 1 (Role 1): Effectively serves as the EDITORIAL HERO with a wide high-oblique view that prioritizes the irrigation context (green crop rows, distant farm structures) while keeping the product small and off-center on the lower third.

Panel 2 (Role 2): Clearly functions as SELECTION EVIDENCE with an elevated technical arrangement. It includes the required visible field evidence (exposed soil and drip tube with emitters) and uses a simple background (distant barn and tractor) that fits the brief without becoming a generic farm shot.

Panel 3 (Role 3): Successfully presents the HEADWORKS STORY with a medium side view of the technical hardware (filter, gauges, regulator, manifold) on wheels, while the product remains small and secondary.
The three panels are visually distinct in camera height, angle, and environmental narrative, with no repetition of layouts or oversized products.
